question.worked_solution:
First, let's swap the left and right-hand sides so that the variable is on the left-hand side.

$$
\frac{t}{4}=-5
$$

In this equation, $t$ is being divided by $4.$ To isolate $t$, we can perform the opposite operation, which is *multiplying* by $4.$ So, we multiply both sides of the equation by $4$ and simplify.

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{t}{4} & =-5 \\ 4\cdot \frac{t}{4} & =4\cdot (-5) \\ \frac{4t}{4} & =-20 \\ \frac{\cancel{4}t}{\cancel{4}} & =-20 \\ t & =-20\end{aligned}
$$
